payload.meta_description: Couples experiences worth travelling for, from sailing the Whitsundays to the Okavango Delta, with when to go and one honest caveat for each of the 20.
payload.excerpt: Twenty couples experiences worth a long-haul flight, grouped by type, each with the months our guides or official sources name and one honest caveat.
payload.author: [[NEEDS: named author]] (open item AUTHOR)
key_takeaways: Each of the 20 experiences sits in a destination we plan; where we give a season, it is worded as our destination guides or an official source give it.
Cheaper or quieter months are often the wet ones: our Maldives cost guide calls May to October the low season, and Smartraveller puts the monsoon at mid-May to November.
Safety, permit and entry rules change, so wherever a card states one, it links the official page at the claim, from Smartraveller to the Great Barrier Reef Marine Park Authority.
One or two headline experiences a week, with open days around them, leaves room for weather, transfers and rest.
Wedded Wonderland Concierge can match each experience to a local specialist and handles deposits, payments and currency across borders through one point of contact.

faq.q: What are good couples experiences abroad?
faq.a: Ones that could only happen there, in a set season, done as two. A Yasawas yacht charter or the Okavango Delta from June to August both qualify.

faq.q: How far ahead should experiences be booked?
faq.a: For the South Pacific dry season and the New Zealand summer, we suggest starting nine to 12 months ahead, because overwater villas, island resorts and boutique lodges are limited in number. Seasonal experiences, such as the Tuscan harvest in September, fix your dates first.

faq.q: Are adventure experiences covered by travel insurance?
faq.a: Often not by default. Smartraveller notes that most travel insurance policies don't include adventure activities and sports, which are usually an optional extra, and that medical assistance is usually the highest unexpected cost for Australians overseas. Tell your insurer about every activity before you do it.

faq.q: Can experiences be added to a honeymoon package?
faq.a: Yes. Travel and Honeymoon Concierge is a step in the Wedded Wonderland Concierge process, so experiences sit in one plan with your stays and transfers.

faq.q: What is a good experience gift for a couple?
faq.a: Planning help from the Wedded Wonderland Concierge, rather than a voucher for one activity. Our Concierge Gift page sets out how to give it.
